evidence.note: isPanelActive requires findTabsForPanel Some and that the group's active tab is this panel; isPanelOpen is that same Option being Some, so active-without-open cannot occur.
OntologyMenuItem writes current from isPanelCurrent/isPanelActive and open from isPanelOpen; a current panel is necessarily present in the workspace.

notes: Panel phase closed|open|current flattened into two combinators over one DockWorkspace.

disqualifier.note: Independent URL/env spike gates; App() if-chains cosmos then graph3d as a priority order over free combinations (both query params can be set), not a masked union.
Independent axes split across SidecarTransport.ipc and the ?ipc=1 QA gate; the panel mounts only on the conjunction, and mixed-false hide paths are legal.
Independent PracticeKgOptions config toggles at the smoke fixture write site; overwrite, includeRefresh, and skipEmails are free combinations, not one build phase.

MCPB manifest user_config wire shape; required on bundle_dir vs corpus_root are independent directory-slot flags mirroring the Claude Desktop/MCPB contract, and mixed true/false is the shipped combination.
